posts.text: Our neighbourhood mesh network now has 85 nodes running. Third attempt at sourdough today and it actually worked. Accidentally made enough banana bread for 54 people. Neighbours are getting some. Took 76 photos at the riverside path and exactly one of them is in focus. Started a reading log and I am already behind by 95 pages. Spent the whole morning at the city archive and saw 59 herons. Is it just me or did Kubernetes get noticeably faster in the last release? 🌱 #Books #FOSS
